A play on Barack Hussein Obama II's last name, citing his roots as a typical Apefrican, bongo beating, bush monkey. Best used when around those who may have a heart attack from hearing the "O" word too many times.
> WWII Veteran: I spent two years of my life flying B-25's out of Italy just so my liberal, white guilt-ridden grandchildren could vote a damn Kenyan nigger as Commander in Chief.
> You: Calm down grandpa, it's not worth raising your blood pressure of that nigger Oba..err Obongo. There isn't a nigger on this planet, even the one in the former White House, that is worth a second of your life.
